notas_originais: , Koh. R. to III, 14, read: חֲמַת גֶּדֶר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (bh הֵן); aqui está, eis.; (introduzindo uma pergunta ou exclamação) como?, de fato!; se.
definicoes_originais: (introducing a question or exclamation) how?, indeed!
notas_originais: הִינָּם, הִינָּן behold, they are. Ned. V, 6 (48 a) והי' לפניך אלא וכ' Bab. ed. (Mish. ואינן; Y. ed. והן בפניך עד) and behold they are before thee (thine), but only in order that my father &c.
Y. Shek. I, 45 d bot. הן נקרא ולא וכ' can we, indeed, read this and not feel ashamed? (Bab. ed. הניקרא, marginal correct. Ms. M. הן נק').
Dan. II, 5, sq.; a. fr.—הן—הן whether— or. Ezra VII, 26.—B. Bath. VII, 2 הן חסר הן יתר whether it be less (than a Beth Kor) or more. Ib. 3; a. e.

B. Mets. 49 a, v. הִין II Mekh. Yithro s. 4 answer על לאו לאו ועל הן הן no to a prohibition and yes to a positive command. Ib. s. 5 ה' וה' yes, indeed; a fr.—Ned. 11 a, a. fr. מכלל לאו אתה שומע הן from the negative we derive the affirmative by implication; Y. ib. I, end, 37 a, a. e. ממשמע לאו וכ'. Men. X, 3 (65 a).

verbetes.glosa_atual: ה'ד־ aquele que.; este, aquele.; o que? YB Mets. II, 8 c לְהָן, v. onde (relativo), onde? Est. R. para I, 12 [leia:] הן דליסטאה מקפח וכ' onde o ladrão ataca, lá ele é executado.
definicoes_originais: what? Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c לְהָן, v. אֲהָן.
where (relat.), where? Esth. R. to I, 12 [read:] הן דליסטאה מקפח וכ' where the robber waylays, there he is executed.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XIX, 1, a. fr. in Ms., ed. Lag. הֲוֹו q. v.—Pesik. Aḥaré, p. 169 b, v. דְּחוּכָא; a. e.

Y. Meg. I, 72 a היך … להן וכ' (Y. Succ. III, 54 a top לדין), v. הֵיךְ. Y. Kil. IX, 32 c top [read:] מה הן שאל להן וכ'; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b top מה הין דשאיל להון (corr. acc.) from all that this one asked that one &c.; a. fr.

Y. Snh. I, 19 a top; Y. Ned. VI, 40 a bot. הן דמטא מטא where he came to, he came to (and his order was obeyed). Y. Kil. IX, 32 c bot. [read:] להן דאשתלחית מינסבינן to the place whither I was sent to take them; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b להון דשלחית (read דאשתלחית). Gen. R. s. 78, v. בְּרָא. Y. Ber. II, 5 c bot. להן ייזיל whither shall he go? Ib. II, 5 a top מן הן הוא where is he from?; a. fr.— Pl. הַנְהוּ, הַנֵּי, הַנָּךְ those, these. Targ. Esth. I, 10; a. e.—Tam. 32 b. B. Mets. 117 a, v. הַהוּא.—Gitt. 6 a הנך … דהני והני בדהנך וכ' those (the inhabitants of Ctesiphon) know the signatures of these (of Ardshir), but the latter do not know &c. Bets. 10 b; a. v. fr.—* Fem. pl. הַנָּן. Y. Bets. V, 63 b top רבנין … מפרשין לה' the Rabbis of Cæsarea report these (controversies) more explicitly (stating the opinion of each by name; Y. Pes. VIII, 36 a top מפרשין להון).—הני מילי (abbrev. הנ"מ) these words (have been said), i.e. this is the case only &c. Ber. 21 a bot. (הוה אמינא) הנ"מ יחיד ויחיד I might have thought this refers only to &c.—Ib. 15 a והנ"מ לק"ש but this applies only to &c.; a. v. fr.—מנא הני מילי, v. מְנָא II.—Emphatic. הַנָּא, הַנָּה. Gen. R. s. 87 הנה טבא וכ' is this (slave) good? Is the omen favorable?; Yalk. ib. 145 הא טב וכ' (corr. acc.).
, v. הֲנִי
Sifré Num. 153 (ref. to הניא, Num. XXX, 6) ה' זו מה היא what this ‘objection’ means; v. הֲפָרָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. הֵמַג) Bar-Henag, sobrenome de uma espécie de abrathah (אַבְרָתָה).
definicoes_originais: (cmp. הֵמַג) Bar-Henag, surname of a species of abrathah (אַבְרָתָה).
notas_originais: Sabb. 109 b (defin. h. אזוב יון).—[ Pl. הִנְגִּין, הִינְ', v. הֵיגְתָא.]
, v. הִינְדְּוָאָה
, v. אַנְטוּבִּין
, v. הִינְ'

) to mark by means of incisions (cmp. כָּסַס). B. Bath. 89 b באתרא דמְהַנְדְּזֵי Ms. (ed. דמְהַנְדְּסֵי) in a place where the authorities mark vessels used for measuring. Ib. (כל) כמה דלא מהנדזי לא שקיל Ar. (Ms. H. כל כמה דלא חזי הינדזא; ed. only לית לן בה) what is beyond the mark of the vessel the purchaser will not accept (merely on the faith of the seller as to the quantity).
Ḥull. 43 a זימנין דמִיהַנְּדְּזִין וכ' at times (when the animal stretches its neck) the perforations in the two skins of the oesophagus may just exactly cover each other.
B. Bath. 89 b, v. preced. Gitt. 60 b ואשקי בה' and use the water in proportion (as much as is due to thy share). [Later Hebr. הַנְדָּסָה geometry.]
, Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII; Yalk. Ps. 670, read: קיּרְיוֹסִין; v. אַפּוֹפְסִין
, v. הִנְדְּקָא
, v. הִינְדִּיקִי
Midr. Till. to Ps. VI חרב ה' an Indian sword.
נהמא דה' Indian bread, a dough roasted on the spit and poured over with oil, or eggs and oil. Ber. 37 b (Asheri דהנדוקא).
, v. הִינְ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: (דקק, com o prefixo ה a. נ inserido; corresponde a h. גַּדְגַּדְנִיּוֹת) melilot, uma espécie de trevo usado como condimento.
definicoes_originais: (דקק, with prefixed ה a. נ inserted; corresp. to h. גַּדְגַּדְנִיּוֹת) melilot, a kind of clover used as a relish.
notas_originais: —Erub. 28 a ה' מדאי Median Melilot. Y. ib. III, 20 d top; Y. Peah VIII, 21 a top.
, v. הָן

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. הֵן) eis que aqui está.
notas_originais: Koh. R. to V, 6 ה' של בו"ד the ‘here is’ of a human being (Esth. VIII, 7), ה' של הק"בה the ‘here is’ of the Lord (Zech. XIV, 1).—הִנֵּנִי here am I. Gen. R. s. 55 ה' לכהונה I am ready for priesthood; a. fr.
, v. הני

verbetes.glosa_atual: (נָהַג) conduzir um animal, uma forma de tomar posse.
definicoes_originais: (נָהַג) driving an animal, a form of taking possession.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 9 a, v. מְשִׁיכָה.
, v. הָן

Gen. R. s. 87, beg. (ref. to Ps. CXXV, 3) אין לו ה' וכ' finds no ease in the company of &c.—הֲנָחַת רוח peace of mind, appeasement. Y. Dem. VII, beg. 26 a (interch. with נחת רוח). Y. Peah I, 15 c bot.; Y. Kidd. I, 61 a bot. בעושה ה' רותו וכ' when he gives his father ease of mind (by obeying his wishes).

definicoes_originais: (נוּחַ Hif.) putting down, depositing, laying down (v. הֵינוּחַ).
notas_originais: Sabb. 22 b, sq. ה' עושה מצוה the real religious ceremony consists in putting the lights in their appropriate place. Ib. 4 a, a. e. עקירה וה' the lifting up (of a burden on the Sabbath) and the putting down.—Kel. VIII, 8 מקום הַנָּחַת העצים the place (in the oven) where the wood is placed. Ib. XXII, 1 מקום הנחת וכ' enough (left of the side board) to set down the cups; enough … to set down portions of meat; Y. Ab. Zar. II, end, 42 a היא מקים ה' הכוסות וכ' (not תחת) both terms mean the same. Taan. 2 b; 4 a משעת הַנָּחָתוֹ from the time it (the Lulab) is stored away (the seventh day of Succoth).
, v. הָן

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de הֲנָאָה), Nif.; ficar satisfeito, desfrutar, lucrar.; para ser apreciado.; beneficiar, entreter, fazer compartilhar.
definicoes_originais: to be pleased, to enjoy, to profit.
to benefit, to entertain, to cause to share.
notas_originais: נֶהֱנֶה (= נֵאוֹת, v. אוֹת I)

B. Kam. 20 a, a. fr. זה נה' the one is benefitted &c., opp. חָסֵר. Ib. II, 2 משלם מה שנֶהֱנֵית he must pay for what the animal has enjoyed (eaten or drunk), contrad. to מה שהזיקה what she has damaged. Ber. 10 b הרוצה לֵהָנוֹת יהָנֶה וכ' (Rashi לֵיהָ') he who desires to make use (of people’s hospitalities), may do so following the example of Elisha. R. Hash. 28 a, a. fr. מצות לא ליהנות ניתנו religious ceremonies are not considered an enjoyment (as regards the use of sacred property &c.); a. v. fr.
Ber. 35 a דבר שנ' something which is enjoyable (can be eaten &c.).

Snh. 92 a אינו מְהַנֶּה ת"ח וכ' allows no scholar to share his wealth. Ber. 63 b bot. ומְהַנֵּהוּ וכ' and invites him to partake of his wealth. Yad. IV, 3 הרי אתה כמְהַנָּן וכ' you appear to benefit them pecuniarily, but &c. Ab. Zar. 16 b sq. שמא דבר מינית … והִנָּאֲךָ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) perhaps a heretical idea was communicated to thee and it pleased thee; Yalk. Prov. 937; a. fr. [Snh. 102 b הֶהֱנָה Hif., marginal note היה מְהַנֶּה; v. Yalk. Kings 207.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) agradar, lucrar.; agradar, fazer o bem, beneficiar.; para entrar em vigor, seja legal.; lucrar, desfrutar, ser gratificado.
notas_originais: Targ. Jer. XXXI, 25 הֲנַתְנִי ed. Lag. (oth. ed. הֲנָאַתְנִי). Targ. Is. XLIV, 10 לַהֲנָאָה (h. text הוֹעִיל); a. e.— Part. הָנֵי. Gen. R. s. 8 עביד מה דה' לך do what pleases thee.— Pl. הַנְיָין. Gen. R. s. 3; s. 9 דין ה' לי יתהון לא ה' לי these (worlds) please me, those did not &c.; Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXIV; Koh. R. to III, 11, v. דֵּן.

Targ. Hab. II, 18; a. fr.—Snh. 99 b bot. מאי אַהֲנוּ לן רבנן (not אהני) what good have the Rabbis done us? Ab. Zar. 14 b אַהֲנָאִי לכון וכ' I did you good inasmuch &c. Y. Ber. I, 4 b bot. ומה מְהַנְיָא ליה (ed. Krot. ומה missing) what good will it do him?; Y. M. Kat. III, 83 c bot. ומה אנים ליה (corr. acc.); a. fr.

Tem. 4 b אי עביד מַהֲנֵי if (what the law forbids) has been done, the act has its legal effect. Ber. 43 a מְהַנְיָא ליה הסבה the lying down of a company for a meal has an influence (in that one says the benediction in behalf of all); a. fr.

Targ. Y. Deut. I, 6 א' לכון it benefitted you (v. Sifré Deut. 5). Targ. O. Gen. XXXVII, 26.—Targ. II Sam. XVII, 16 דלמא יִתְהֲנִי וכ' (ed. Wil. יִתַּהֲנִי) perhaps it will please the king (h. text יְבֻלַּע). Targ. Ez. XVI, 31; a. e.—Ned. 50 a דאִיתְהֲנִי וכ' that I should enjoy this world’s goods. Ḥag. 15 a לִיתְהֲנֵי וכ' let him (myself) enjoy the world. Yeb. 103 a מִתְהַנְיָא מעבירה she derived gratification from a sinful act. Y. Snh. X, 29 b top ובר נש לא מִתְהֲנֵי כלום (not מתהנים) and none were benefitted; a. fr.
, v. הֲנָיָיה ch.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de נֵאוֹת, v. אוֹת I; cmp. נָאֶה) gozo, prazer, benefício.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of נֵאוֹת, v. אוֹת I; cmp. נָאֶה) enjoyment, pleasure, benefit.
notas_originais: Taan. 8 a מאי ה' יש לך what does it profit thee (to bite)?—Sifré Deut. 5 (ref. to רב, Deut. I, 6) ה' גדולה וכ' your dwelling &c. was of great benefit to you; a. v. fr.—Snh. 26 b, a. fr. בעל ה' a worldling.—נדר ה' מן to vow refusal of any benefit or favor from a person. Ned. IV, 1, sq.; a. fr.—Kidd. 41 a דור ה' ממנו vow that you will have no favor at his hands. [Sifra B’har ch. III, Par. 3 הניית, v. הוֹנָיָיה.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Jer. XVI, 19. Targ. Koh. II, 2; 12.-Targ. Y.Lev. V, 16 הַנְיַית קודשא gozo de propriedade sagrada. Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVII, 26; um. frag.—Ex. R.s. 6, fim; Tanḥ. Vaëra 2 (prov.) מן שטייא לית הנייא וכ' das acácias não há prof
notas_originais: Targ. Jer. XVI, 19. Targ. Koh. II, 2; 12.—Targ. Y. Lev. V, 16 הַנְיַית קודשא enjoyment of sacred property. Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVII, 26; a. fr.—Ex. R. s. 6, end; Tanḥ. Vaëra 2 (prov.) מן שטייא לית הנייא וכ' of acacias there is no profit except you cut them down, i.e. a wicked man can be converted by suffering only.—Taan. 23 b מקרבא הַנְיָיתָהּ Rashi (ed. הנייתא) what good she does is a direct one (by giving bread); ואנא … ולא מקרבא הנייתיה (read: הַנְיָיתִי) but I give money, and what good I do is indirect; Keth. 67 b ומקרבן אהנייתי (read: ומקרבא הַנְיָיתִי, or ומקרבן הֲנָיָיתַי, pl.).—Y. B. Bath. V, 16 b bot. בנוי דה' (cmp. מַעֲלֵי) good, worthy children.—2) loveliness, beauty (cmp. נָאֶה). Targ. Ps. XXIII, 2 הַנְיַית דיתאין loveliness of plants (h. text נְאוֹת!).
, v. preced.
, v. הֲנָפָה
, v. הַנֵּץ
, v. הֲנָיָיה ch.
, v. הָן

Y. Ber. IX, 14 b bot.; Y. Sot. V, 20 c bot. [read:] פרוש מן הנ' מן מאי דאית לי אנא מנכי עביד מצוה a Pharisee ‘from deduction’ (who says), I take from what is mine (I stint myself) in order to do a good deed.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (homileticamente = חִנָּם; v. ה"א) ato gratuito e sem propósito, vaidade.
definicoes_originais: (homiletically = חִנָּם; v. ה"א) gratuitous, purposeless act, vanity.
notas_originais: Erub. 19 a (play on גיהנם) גיא … שהכל יורדין בה על עסקי ה' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50) the valley which all enter for affairs of vanity (worldly lusts).
, v. הָן

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Inf. Hif. de נוּף) cerimônia de aceno no Templo.
definicoes_originais: (Inf. Hif. of נוּף) waving ceremony in the Temple.
notas_originais: —יום ה' (Lev. XXIII, 10—12) the second day of Passover. R. Hash. IV, 3; Succ. III, 12; Y. Ḥall. I, 57 c top; a. e.—Tosef. Arakh. I, 11 ביום ה' on the same week-day as the second day of Passover; Arakh. 9 b; v. עִיבּוּר.

Pesik. R. s. 41 (ref. to יפה נוף Ps. XLVIII, 3) היפה בהֲנָפַת העומר שלה who is beautiful when she waves the Omer; Yalk. Ps. 755; Yalk. Ex. 417 בהֲנִיפָתָהּ.—Y. Maasr. II, 50 a top הֲנָפַת מגל the swinging of the sickle.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (נפק) produzindo perante o tribunal, esp. o endosso legal de uma nota, informando que ela foi apresentada em juízo e considerada válida.
definicoes_originais: (נפק) producing before court, esp. the legal endorsement of a note, stating that it has been produced in court and found valid.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 7 b; 16 b; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [a flor,] nome de uma moeda; por favor. (através de falsa analogia, v. דָּרוֹסָה) הִנְצִין, הִינְצִין.
definicoes_originais: [ the blossom,] name of a coin; pl. (through false analogy, v. דָּרוֹסָה) הִנְצִין, הִינְצִין.
notas_originais: Tosef. B. Bath. V, 12 a; Kidd. 12 a, v. נֵץ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Inf. Hif. de נָצַץ) cintilante, ה' החמה os primeiros brilhos do sol nascente.
definicoes_originais: (Inf. Hif. of נָצַץ) sparkling, ה' החמה the first sparklings of the rising sun.
notas_originais: Taan. III, 9. Ber. I, 2; a. fr.

Men. 69 a שתי … ה' שריין וכ' (Rashi) does the offering of the two loaves cause the permission to use plants which had sprouted forth at the time of the offering, or is a distinct formation of fruits required?, v. חֲנָטָה. Ib. ה' דפירא the coming forth of the fruit, ה' דעלה of the foliage.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (תוך, תכך, com prefixo הנ; cmp. הנדקוקא) teto com painéis.
definicoes_originais: (תוך, תכך, with prefix הנ; cmp. הנדקוקא) pannelled ceiling.
notas_originais: Targ. I Kings VI, 9 (h. text גֵּבִים).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (סבב, Hif.) colocar os divãs ao redor da mesa; em.
definicoes_originais: (סבב, Hif.) placing the divans around the table; in.
notas_originais: gen. banquet, meal in company (v. מֵסֵב). Y. Maasr. IV, 51 b top עשה הי' בשדה if one arranges a meal in company in the field. Y. B. Bath. IX, 16 d bot. ועשה לו ה' וכ' and he made the wedding meal for him in the triclinium. Y. Taan. IV, 68 a bot. סדר ה' the position of couches at a banquet. Ib. the patriarchs lie in the grave דרך ה' in the same position to one another as at meals (distinction between seniors and juniors; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Triclinium).

verbetes.glosa_atual: mesmo; deitado para uma refeição em companhia.
definicoes_originais: same; lying down for a meal in company.
notas_originais: Ber. 43 a, v. הֲנִי. Ib. היסבה (Ms. M. הֶסֵּב), v. preced. Ib. 52 b הֶסֵּבַּת גוים Ms. M. (ed. מְסִבַּת) a banqueting of gentiles. Pes. 108 a הֶסּיבַּת ימין lying on the right side at the Passover meal; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (סבב; v. Num. XXXVI, 7) a transferência de propriedade fundiária de uma tribo para outra.
definicoes_originais: (סבב; v. Num. XXXVI, 7) the transfer of landed property from one tribe to another.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 111 b הֶסֵּבַּת הבעל ed. (Ms. H. a. Rashb. סִבַּת, סִיבַּת) the transfer which would be caused by the husband’s succeding to his wife’s property. Ib. 112 a ה' הבן Ms. R. (ed. סיבת, סבת) the eventual transfer through the son’s succession.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (סָגַר; v. Lev. XIII, 4, a. e.) trancafiar o leproso para julgamento; cmp. הֶחֱלֵט.
definicoes_originais: (סָגַר; v. Lev. XIII, 4, a. e.) locking up the leper for trial; cmp. הֶחֱלֵט.
notas_originais: Y. Meg. I, 71 b מתוך ה' after being locked up. Y. M. Kat. III, 82 c bot.; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: f. mesmo. Lev. R.s. 17 אין ה' וכ' trancar (סגר, I Sam. XVII, 46) alude à lepra.
notas_originais: f. same. Lev. R. s. 17 אין ה' וכ' locking up (סגר, I Sam. XVII, 46) alludes to leprosy.
Num. R. s. 23 והָסוּ כל וכ' and all Israel was silenced before him (to listen to him); Tanḥ. Masé 5 הסבו; ed. Bub. 4 וחסו.
, Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26 a, read: אכל חסחוסים, v. הַסְחוּס

verbetes.glosa_atual: (נָסַע) = precedido. w., (com ou sub. הַדַּעַת) descartando, desistindo.
definicoes_originais: (נָסַע) = preced. w., (with or sub. הַדַּעַת) discarding, giving up.
notas_originais: Y. Pes. I, 28 b top ה' דבר תורה, v. הֶיסֵּחַ. Y. Shek. VII, beg. 50 c ה' דעת טעון וכ' sacrificial meat whose existence has been forgotten (is unfit and) requires decomposition before it is burnt. Y. Meg. IV, 75 c top מפני ה' ד' because his attention may be diverted (by looking at the priests); Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67 b מסיע (corr. acc.). Y. Pes. X, 37 d bot. מפני ה' הד' because the thought of eating it has been abandonned.
Ar., v. חֲסַם

verbetes.glosa_atual: (סָפַד) cerimônias fúnebres, manifestações de luto, discurso fúnebre, elogio etc. M. Kat. III, 8 שלא להרגיל את הה' para não provocar lamentação.
definicoes_originais: (סָפַד) funeral ceremonies, manifestations of mourning, funeral address, eulogy &c. M. Kat. III, 8 שלא להרגיל את הה' in order not to invite lamentation.
notas_originais: Tosef. ib. II, 17 ה' על לב hesped means beating on the heart. Y. Ber. III, 6 b top [read:] הסופד וכל העסוקין בה' (v. Tosef. ib. II, 11 ed. Zuck., Var.) the leader of the lamentation and all those engaged in it. Y. Succ. V, 55 b bot. הֶסְפֵּידוֹ של וכ' the mourning for &c. Sabb. 153 a מהספדו של אדם וכ' from the way a person is mourned for you can learn whether he deserves future happiness; a. fr.—קשר ה' to compose and arrange a funeral song. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15 d top מצא ה' קשור וכ' found that lamentations were prepared in his house. Y. Yoma I, 38 b; Y. Sot. I, end, 17 d. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joh. 1).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Lam. Eu, 18; um. e.—Ber. 6b. Sucesso. 52a; um. frag.
notas_originais: Targ. Lam. I, 18; a. e.—Ber. 6 b. Succ. 52 a; a. fr.

Yoma 22 b דאוריה ודה' the sin against Uriah and that of counting the people to which he was enticed (II Sam. XXIV, 1). Ḥull. 4 b אין ה' בדברים enticing (the verb הסית) never applies to verbal persuasion (but only to sensual influences). Sifré Deut. 87 אין ה' אלא טעות enticing means leading astray; אין ה' אלא גירוי it means instigation.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Infin. Hif. de סָתַר) ה' פנים (de Deut. XXXI, 18) ocultação de rosto, raiva divina, recusa em responder à oração.
definicoes_originais: (Infin. Hif. of סָתַר) ה' פנים (from Deut. XXXI, 18) hiding of face, divine anger, refusal to answer prayer.
notas_originais: Ḥag. 5 a כל שאינו בה' פ' וכ' he who is not subject to the hiding of face (who does not suffer under general persecution) is none of them (not of Israelitish descent). Ib. b

verbetes.glosa_atual: (עָבַר); carregando, carregando.; (= הַעֲבָרַת קול) fazendo com que o som passe por um determinado espaço, proclamação.; conduzindo, passando; em geração. uso do radical עבר.
definicoes_originais: (= הַעֲבָרַת קול) causing the sound to pass over a certain space, proclamation.
leading across, passing; in gen. use of the stem עבר.
(from Num. VIII, 7, VI, 5, a. e.) הַעֲבָרַת שיער passing the razor over the hair, shaving.
notas_originais: R. Hash. 27 b, a. e. (ref. to והעברת, Lev. XXV, 9) דרך הַעֲבָרָתוֹ (leave the horn) in the way in which it was borne by the living animal (in its natural shape).
Ib. 34 a דיליף ה' ה' ממשה Ms. M. (ed. דגמר עברה ע') we learn the meaning of העביר (Lev. l. c.) from the meaning it has in reference to Moses (Ex. XXXVI, 6). Sabb. 96 b; Yalk. Ex. 413.

Y. Snh. VII, 25 b bot. (interch. with עברה); Sifra K’doshim ch. VIII, Par. 4 מה ה' וכ' as the ‘passing’ there (Deut. XVIII, 10) means through fire, so does the ‘passing’ here (Lev. XVIII, 21). Bekh. 32 a ה' ה' ממעשר analogy between the first-born and the tithes founded on the use of the stem עבר (Ex. XIII, 12, a. Lev. XXVII, 32); (Zeb. 9 a, a. e. עברה).
Naz. 58 b, sq. ה' ש' removing the hair of the body. Y. ib. II, end, 52 b לה' ש' for the purpose of removing the hair, opp. גידול שיער.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (עוּד, Hif.) testemunho, depoimento.; (יָעַד) advertência dada ao dono de animal travesso (Ex. XXI, 29); lei relativa a danos a pagar após aviso, v.
definicoes_originais: (יָעַד) warning given to the owner of a mischievous animal (Ex. XXI, 29); law concerning damages payable after warning, v. מוּעָד.
notas_originais: B. Mets. 3 a, b הַעֲדָאַת עדים evidence through witnesses; a. e.
B. Kam. 18 b יש ה' וכ' the law &c. applies to &c. (and full damages must be paid). Y. ib. II, beg. 2 d; a. fr.

Keth. 43 a לה' concerning the surplus of the value of labor over the cost of sustenance. Ib. 66 a ה' ע"י הדחק a surplus gained through an extraordinary exertion. B. Kam. 87 b. Gitt. 12 a; a. e.—Ib. b לה' for additional support (not included in the sustenance furnished by the master).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (עָלָה Hif.); (fr. Lev. XIX, 19) jogar sobre os ombros, embrulhar, opp. para לבישה vestir um vestido.; trazer, oferecer no altar, colocar na mesa.; (v. Lev. XVI, 9) tirando o sorteio da urna.
definicoes_originais: (fr. Lev. XIX, 19) throwing over one’s shoulders, wrapping, opp. to לבישה putting on of a dress.
bringing up, offering on the altar, placing on the table.
(v. Lev. XVI, 9) taking the lot out of the ballot box.
notas_originais: Yeb. 4 b. Yoma 69 a
Pesik. R. s. 16, end כדי ה' אחת sufficient for one offering; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 10. Ḥull. 104 a ואנן נגזר ה' and shall we forbid the serving on the table for fear that &c.?
Y. Yoma IV, 41 c top.

verbetes.glosa_atual: c. (Inf. Nif. de עָלַם) sendo desconhecido, esp. (com referência a Lev. IV a V) inconsciência, esquecimento como causa de uma transgressão.
definicoes_originais: c. (Inf. Nif. of עָלַם) being unknown, esp. (with ref. to Lev. IV to V) unconsciousness, forgetfulness as the cause of a transgression.
notas_originais: Shebu. 26 a ה' שבועה forgetting that he had sworn; ה' חפץ forgetting the subject of the oath. Sabb. 70 b ה' שבת unconsciousness of its being the Sabbath day; ה' מלאכות of the sinful nature of those labors. Ib. אם עשאן … בה' אחד if he did all the forbidden labors in one state of unconsciousness (without being reminded between); Y. ib. III, 9 b top בה' אחת. Ib. I, 2 b בעלם אחד (interch. with בהעלם); B. Bath. 55 b בה' (Ms. H. בעלם); Ker. IV, 2 (17 b) בה' אחת; ib. III, 2 בה' אחד. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, Par. 1, ch. I; a. fr.— Pl. הֵעָלֵימוֹת. Y. Sabb. l. c. בשני ה' in two discontinuous states of forgetfulness. Y. Shebu. I, 32 d top כמה ידיעות וה' many moments of consciousness and intervening forgetfulness. Y. Snh. VII, 24 c top; a. e.—Usu. הַעֲלָמוֹת (fr. הַעֲלָמָה, v. next w.), or הֵעָלֵמוֹת. Sabb. 80 a בשתי ה'; Ker. 17 a; B. Bath. l. c. בשני ה'. Tosef. Ker. III, 2; 7 בשני ה'; a. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, 1 הָעֲלָמוֹת, v. עֶלֶם.]

Shebu. 4 a ה' למלקות מאי עבידתיה how can an act committed through forgetfulness be punished with lashes?—Ib. 14 b ה' היא is this to be considered a sin committed through ignorance (not preceded by knowledge)?— Pl. הַעֲלָמוֹת, v. preced.

B. Kam. 34 a, a. e. כשעת ה' בדין according to the condition of the animal at the time of appearance in court. Bekh. 32 b, a. e. בעי ה' והערכה must be placed (before the priest) and appraised (Lev. XXVII, 11). Ib. בכלל ה' וכ' subject to the law requiring placing &c. Yoma 41 b אה' קאי does it refer to the placing of the sacrifice (to והעמידו, Mish. ib.)?—Y. Maas. III, 54 c top ה' והערכה (interchanging with עמדה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Inf. Hif. de עָנַק, com referência a Deut. XV, 14) o equipamento do escravo emancipado.
definicoes_originais: (Inf. Hif. of עָנַק, with ref. to Deut. XV, 14) the outfitting of the emancipated slave.
notas_originais: Kidd. 17 b לה' (‘and also to thy handmaid shalt thou do likewise’, Deut. XV, 17) refers to the outfit (not to the marking of the ear); Y. ib. I, 59 c bot.; Sifré Deut. 122.
, v. הַעֲרָיָיה

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Inf. Hif. de עָרַב) ה' שמש pôr do sol, necessário para que a pessoa impura, após a purificação, fique totalmente limpa (Lev. XI, 27; a. fr.).
definicoes_originais: (Inf. Hif. of עָרַב) ה' שמש sunset, required for the unclean person, after purification, to be entirely clean (Lev. XI, 27; a. fr.).
notas_originais: Yoma 6 a והא בעי ה' הש' does he not require the sunset to pass before he may officiate?; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de עֶרֶב); indo para casa à noite depois do trabalho (= הַכְנָסָה), opp. para הַשְׁכָּמָה.; trabalho noturno.
definicoes_originais: going home in the evening from labor (= הַכְנָסָה), opp. to הַשְׁכָּמָה.
notas_originais: Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11 b [read:] שתהא השכמה משל בעה"ב וה' משל פועלין that the time needed for going out &c., v. הוֹצָאָה 4). Ib. (not ערבית) ובערבי שבתות בין … ה' וכ' on Sabbath eves both are deducted from the employer’s time.
Lev. R. s. 19; Midr. Sam. ch. V דברי תורה צריכין השחרה וה' הפרנסה מנין the words of the Law require early and late study, whence shall sustenance come?

verbetes.glosa_atual: (עָרָה, v. Lev. XX, 18) contato sexual, o primeiro estágio da conexão sexual.
definicoes_originais: (עָרָה, v. Lev. XX, 18) sexual contact, the first stage of sexual connection.
notas_originais: Tosef. Sot. I, 2; Y. ib. I, 16 c bot. כדי ה' time long enough for arriving at the intimacy of the first stage. Yeb. 55 b, a. e. ה' זו הכנסת וכ', v. הַכְנָסָה; a. fr.
Bekh. 32 b; a. e., v. הַעֲמָדָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (עָרַם) trapaça, evasão legal, meios impróprios para evitar um dever religioso.
definicoes_originais: (עָרַם) trickery, legal evasion, improper means to avoid a religious duty.
notas_originais: Y. Peah V, 19 b bot.; Y. Ned. IV, end, 38 d לא חשו לה' the Rabbis did not apprehend an evasion. Ib. V, end, 39 b a donation like that of Beth-Horon (v. Mish. ib. 7) שהיתה בה' which was made for the sake of circumventing (a vow). Tosef. B. Mets. IV, 3 הַעֲרָמַת ריבית an evasion of the law of usury; B. Mets. 62 b; Y. ib. V, 10 b top; a. fr.

, Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 12, v. חָפוּת

definicoes_originais: Haftarah, prophetic lesson read in Synagogue after the reading from the Pentateuch, v. אַפְטַרְתָּא.
notas_originais: . Gen. R. s. 69, end.
Meg. 30 b.— Pl. הַפְטָרוֹת. Ib.; a. e.
Ar., v. חוּפְיָא

adv., v. הֲפַךְ.
Targ. Prov. X, 31 Ms. (ed. דהֲפִיכוּ).— Pl. הֲפִיכָתָא perverse things, perverseness. Ib. XVI, 30.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (הָפַךְ) revirar, deslocar, como símbolo de posse.
definicoes_originais: (הָפַךְ) upturning, displacing, as a symbol of possession.
notas_originais: Y. B. Kam. III, 3 c bot., contrad. to הַגְבָּהָה. [הֲפִיכוֹת, v. הֲפֵכָה.]
Targ. Prov. X, 31, v. הָפִיכָא.
, v. הֲפֶכְתָּא
Gen. R. s. 100 יוסי ה'; v. חֵפָנִי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); (ato. verbo) virar; mudar; reverter; perverter, subverter, destruir.; (verbo neutro) mudar.; ser revirado, destruído; para ser alterado.
definicoes_originais: (act. verb) to turn; to change; to reverse; to pervert, subvert, destroy.
to be upturned, destroyed; to be changed.
to be changed, disguise one’s self.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 18 הָפְכָה המדינה שעבודה וכ' a country perverted the rules of forced labor for the captives (treating them inhumanely); ה' עליהם את הדין וכ' he changed the law against them and put them to death by night (against the Jewish law, v. Snh. IV, 1). Ib. ה' סדום He destroyed Sodom. Ber. 55 b כשם שהָפַכְתָּ וכ' as thou didst turn the curse … into blessing, כן הֲפוֹךְ וכ' so do thou turn &c. B. Kam. III, 3 ההוֹפֵךְ את הגלל he who upturns (changes the place of) the dung (taking possession); a. v. fr.— Part. Pass. הָפוּךְ. Pes. 50 a עולם ה' ראיתי וכ' I saw a reversed world, the uppermost below &c. Sabb. 108 b הֲפוּכָה סדום וכ' Sodom is subverted and what is said about it is perverted. Sifra Thazr. Par. 3, ch. III הפוך, הפוכה when its color is changed; a. v. fr.—Y. Naz. V, end, 54 b לשון הפוך, v. הֶפֶךְ.
Sifra ch. IV אי כולי ה' לבן if the whole of it has turned white. Neg. IV, 3; a. fr.
Yalk. Esth. 1056 כשנ' סדום when Sodom was subverted. Gen. R. s. 50 ומדינה נֶהְפֶּכֶת, v. אִדְרַבְלָא. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 25 נ' להם מן וכ' the voice turned around, as if coming from &c.; a. fr.

Gen. R. s. 20 שהי' דברים וכ' who spoke perversely of the Creator. Kidd. 59 a עני מְהַפֵּךְ וכ' a poor man turns the cake, and another comes and takes it, i.e. one who buys away what another is negotiating for.
נִתְהַפֵּךְ
Gen. R. s. 21 end שהם מִתְהַפְּכִים they (the angels) assume various shapes.

Ib. שהיא מִתְהַפֶּכֶת וכ' for it (the fiery sword) turns around man &c. Yeb. 35 a; Keth. 37 a מתהפכת she turns herself (makes violent motions). Ib. נִתְהַפְּכָה (Keth. l. c. נֶהֶפְכָה).—Tanḥ. Vayetsé 11 היה מ' עליו prevaricated (changing terms).
Ruth R. introd. 3 שהוא מִתְהפֵּךְ ובא וכ' he (Esaw = Rome) schemes and comes against &c.; Yalk. Prov. 959 בא ומְהַפֵּךְ על וכ'. Ib. שהם מִתְהַפְּכִים וכ'; Ruth R. l. c. שמְהַפְּכִין.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , mesmo (v. אֲפַךְ); virar, mudar.; derrubar, destruir.; (verbo neutro) virar.
definicoes_originais: (with ב) to be engaged in, to handle.
l) (= h. הֵשִׁיב) to turn; to bring back, restore; to turn off (wrath), to appease; to give in return, reply.
to be turned, changed; to turn about, deal in &c. Targ. Lev. XIII, 3.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. CV, 29; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15 d ה' אפוי he turned his face off.
. Targ. Gen. XIX, 25; a. fr.

Targ. Prov. XXVI, 11; a. e.—Num. R. s. 12 כהדין ברנש … הָפוּךְ לאחוריו like one going down a ladder backwards; Y. R. Hash. II, 58 a כאילין דסלקין בסולמא הֲפִיךְ like those who ascend a ladder backward; Yalk. Job 912 [read:] כהדין דסלקין בסולמא הפוך (v. Lattes Saggio p. 106).

Pes. 113 a (prov.) הֲפוֹךְ בנבילתא ולא תֵיפוֹךְ וכ' deal in carcasses, but deal not in words (gossip, sophistry &c.). Y. B. Kam. IV, beg. 4 a אנא הפך ומתהפך בדידי וכ' I turn around my stock of goods (selling and buying again), so that I reach thee in profits. Ab. V, 22 הֲפוֹךְ בה וכ' study it over and again; a. fr.—V. הֲפִיכָא.

Targ. Prov. XXV, 13.—Ib. XXIX, 8.—Ib. XXIV, 29 Ms. (ed. אַהֲפֵיךְ Af.).—Ib. 26.—2) to handle, be engaged in, barter, study (v. Pe. 4). Kidd. 59 a דוה מְהַפֵּיךְ בההיא וכ' was negotiating about a field. Sabb. 119 a כמה דלא מְהַפִּיכְנָא בזכותיה before I study what might be said in his favor. Pes. 40 a דמְהַפְּכֵי כיפי who handle sheaves; כי מְהַפְּכִיתוּ הַפִּיכוּ וכ' (Ms. M. הפכיתו) when ye handle (them), handle them with the thought that they will be used for a religious purpose.— Part. pass. מְהַפַּךְ. Y. Maasr. III, end, 51 a היא הפכה והיא מְהַפְּכָה it turns and is turned in all directions (studied over and again), but we can learn nothing from it.
, v. supra.
Targ. Job XXX, 21; a. fr.—Y. Maasr. III, end, 51 a, v. supra.
Targ. Jud. VII, 13; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedeu. wds.); reverso, oposto.; revirar (uma pilha), deslocar.
notas_originais: לְשׁוֹן ה' a phrase which means the reverse (euphemism). Y. Naz. II, 51 d bot. (ed. Krot. הפר, corr. acc.); ib. V, end, 54 b לָשׁוֹן הָפוּךְ.
B. Kam. 29 b כל ה' למטה וכ' the term ‘upturning’ means a movement within three cubits (Var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80).
— Pl. הֲפֵכוֹת, הֲפֵי'. Ber. 55 b שלש ה' three verses in which change (the expression הפך) occurs.
— Pl. הַפְכָנִין. Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 20.
Yalk. Esth. 1056, v. next w.— Pl. הֲפַכְפָּכִין. Ruth R. introd., 3; Yalk. Deut. 945 (Sifré Deut. 320 הֲפַכְפְּכָנִים, v. next w.).
Meg. 15 b (Yalk. Esth. 1056, v. preced.).— Pl., v. preced.
